stocks:MSFT.standing: Shares in the maker of Windows, Office and the Azure cloud, one of the world's most valuable companies. Its OpenAI stake and its data-centre spending make it a bellwether for whether the AI build-out pays.
stocks:MSFT.recent: Microsoft's own services failed: Outlook and Teams were disrupted for nearly a day, Downdetector logged 130,000 Outlook reports at the peak, and the shares fell 3% amid the disruptions. The same week a researcher leaked SignDrop, a Windows exploit that gives ordinary users System rights.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: The latest fighting has been between Iran and the US, not Israel. After the US bombed Qeshm Island, Iran struck an airbase used by US forces in Kuwait and hit Bahrain several times, while peace talks stalled. None of it accounts for the earlier climb in the price.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive, leaving Colette Kress, its finance chief since 2013, in charge. He fell amid a US-China spy scandal tied to Megaspeed, a Singapore firm now under criminal probe over chip diversion. Trump then backed his return, and Nvidia doubled profit to $65.3 billion without him.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: An attack struck Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline and Houthi militias claimed one on Riyadh's financial centre, yet Brent fell below $90 for the first time since August as Saudi output rose 26% in October. Iraq's Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline pumped crude again after a decade, and Brent jumped minutes after a Trump post on Iran.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: The prediction-market stories of the fortnight were about the platforms themselves, chiefly Trump Jr. leaving Kalshi after his firm's $300 million investment in Polymarket, and none of them concerns Hegseth or explains the swing in this contract.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: The strait became more of a war zone, not less: Iran's navy says mines hit 4 tankers in 24 hours, and after the US bombed Qeshm Island, Tehran struck an airbase in Kuwait and hit Bahrain repeatedly. Peace talks are stalled, a third US carrier has reached the Gulf, and insuring a single transit now costs $64m.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: A system outage stalled United's departures for 90 minutes on Monday, one of a run of failures within six days that also hit Microsoft, the FAA, Chase and Apple Pay. Days earlier it barred AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights. Neither event accounts for the share's earlier climb.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The trough came as SpaceX's default risk hit a fresh peak in a tech-led selloff. Since then it has announced $74 billion in AI computing campuses, caught a Starship upper stage after 14 orbits, and faced a European Commission demand to lift Starshield limits that cut off Ukraine's drones above 161 km/h.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: Huang left Nvidia after a confession email to staff about an affair with the head of a Singapore-based company, and Colette Kress, its finance chief since 2013, took over. Megaspeed, the Singapore firm Alice Huang left in August 2025, now faces a criminal probe, and Trump has backed his return as 177,000 people petition for it.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Reserve Bank of India leaves its repo rate, the rate at which it lends to commercial banks, unchanged at its December meeting. That rate sets the cost of borrowing across India.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.recent: The fortnight's rate news came from Washington: Fed minutes showed almost all officials expecting more hikes, and Waller said the Fed should consider a half-point move. None of it concerned the RBI, and none of it accounts for this contract.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight's news from Alibaba was of expansion, not setback: its Qwen model became the AI behind Siri on Chinese iPhones, it said it would list its T-Head chip unit in Hong Kong while keeping control, and it launched an AI music app. None of it accounts for the fall in the share price.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, closes its first day of public trading worth less than $1.25 trillion. It is a wager on how the market will price one of the largest AI developers.
poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.recent: The fortnight's news on prediction markets was about the industry itself: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket. None of it concerns Anthropic or a listing, so none of it accounts for this price.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty, and a day later the UN watchdog called on Tehran to reopen facilities it has not inspected since the US-Israeli attacks. Washington's offer of up to $20 million for informants on the program showed it was still working without inspectors on the ground.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou is doubling down on Kling, its AI video generator, which earned over $20 million in December 2025 alone. That story arrived after the slide had run its course, and nothing reported about the company's own business in this window accounts for the fall.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries, based in Ningde, Fujian, and listed in Shenzhen. Its cells go into cars from Tesla to BMW, so its share moves on Chinese EV sales, lithium prices and Western trade rules.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a peace deal before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, battlefield turns and Washington's diplomacy.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: Trump claimed a 'big, beautiful agreement' was coming before the Abu Dhabi talks, the first between Russia and Ukraine in 9 months, but Putin was not ready to make peace there. The US then floated a NATO seat for Kyiv in exchange for leaving Donbas, and both sides escalated instead: Ukraine hit the Kerch bridge, and Russia struck the bridges of Kyiv.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Chiang Wan-an, the Kuomintang mayor of Taipei, wins the city's next mayoral race. Taiwan's capital has twice sent its mayor on to the presidency, so the seat is read as a test of the parties' national strength.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire before its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on a truce, not a forecast of one.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: Traders bid the truce up after Iran, at talks in Islamabad, shortened its plan to reopen Hormuz from 7 days to 2. They sold it off when the US bombed Qeshm Island, Iran's base at the strait's mouth, and Tehran answered with strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain, the Gulf states that host US forces, while the peace talks stalled.

stocks:UPS.standing: United Parcel Service, the Atlanta-based carrier that moves parcels by truck and by its own cargo airline, hubbed at Louisville. Its volumes track consumer spending and online shopping, and its costs track fuel and labour contracts.

stocks:HMC.standing: Honda's American depositary shares on the New York Stock Exchange, priced in dollars. The Tokyo company is the world's largest motorcycle maker and a major carmaker, so the yen and US tariffs on Japanese cars both reach this price.
stocks:HMC.recent: Honda reported profit up 66%, carried by its motorcycles while its car business still lost money. That result landed after the chart's last close, so it does not account for the move within it.

poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the first lawmaker Israel's president asks to form a government after the 2026 vote succeeds, so that no second candidate is handed the mandate. Each failed round brings Israel closer to another election.
poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.recent: The bet turns on whether the candidate Israel's president tapped can assemble a coalition before the deadline. It slid while a former prime minister played kingmaker, and steadied once Eisenkot opened unity talks with Netanyahu, the man he says must go, as the opposition called the arrest of 3 Arab-party members a coup.

stocks:COL.AX.standing: Coles Group runs one of Australia's two dominant supermarket chains, alongside Woolworths, plus liquor stores such as Liquorland. Its shares trade on food inflation, wage costs and regulators' scrutiny of grocery pricing.
stocks:COL.AX.recent: The one story about Coles was its disclosure of a cyber attack, made without saying what happened. That disclosure came after this window closed, so it does not account for the slide.

stocks:WOW.AX.standing: Australia's largest supermarket chain, which also owns the Big W discount stores and the New Zealand Countdown grocery network. Its prices and margins sit at the centre of the country's long-running argument over the cost of food.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest memory-chip maker after Samsung, and the leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside Nvidia's AI processors. Its share price is a read on how much the AI build-out is spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: The fortnight's news on SK Hynix was about building: crews working 24/7 on its first fab at Yongin, a plant set to stand 150 metres tall, and a $1 billion fund with a testing hub for smaller Korean chip suppliers. None of it explains the fall in the share.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the biggest seller of cloud computing. AWS earns most of the company's operating profit, so the share moves on cloud demand as much as on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: A United Launch Alliance Vulcan rocket failed 10 minutes after liftoff and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites, a setback for the company's satellite network; the launcher then blamed its fuel supply, not Blue Origin's engines. The loss came after the share's climb, and nothing in the input accounts for the price itself.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.
stocks:DBK.DE.recent: Shares dropped after a leak of 15 million internal files showed Deutsche Bank kept about 28,000 flagged clients on its books. A May 2020 memo tied two Trump companies to laundromats, and staff played down accusations against Brazilian clients Vale, Braskem and Safra to keep their business.

stocks:CBK.DE.standing: Germany's second-largest listed bank, based in Frankfurt and a main lender to the Mittelstand, the mid-sized firms behind German exports. The German state has held a stake in it since rescuing it in the 2008 crisis.
stocks:CBK.DE.recent: UniCredit's €45 billion bid for the bank won unconditional EU approval, after the US Fed had also approved. Competition chief Teresa Ribera warned that Brussels will intervene if Berlin tries to block it. It is the first big cross-border bank merger the EU's banking union was built to allow.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by year's end. Funding rounds and share sales set that valuation, so the price moves on news of either.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, joining the Chase consumer bank to one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its shares are read as a gauge of US credit, consumer spending and dealmaking.
stocks:JPM.recent: Nearly 5,000 Chase customers reported outages on Monday, by Downdetector's count, in a six-day stretch when Microsoft, the FAA and Apple Pay also went down. The same day JPMorgan linked its blockchain deposit network with DBS for 24/7 dollar transfers. Neither event lines up with the share's high or its low.

poly-will-jensen-huang-rejoin-nvidia-by-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, who co-founded NVIDIA and ran it as chief executive for three decades, returns to the company before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for a yes.

stocks:AVIO.MI.standing: Avio builds Europe's Vega small-satellite rockets and the solid-fuel boosters that lift Ariane 6, from its works at Colleferro near Rome. It is the continent's main alternative to buying launches from SpaceX.
stocks:AVIO.MI.recent: Early in the month Avio scaled back a demonstrator programme over technical challenges. Then ICEYE bid €41 a share, a 21.3% premium and €2.05 billion in all, and pledged €1 billion more of investment in Italy. The Finnish radar-satellite operator wants its own launcher, and the Italian state, which holds a stake in Avio, has a golden-power veto over the sale.

wiki-artificial-intelligence.standing: The English Wikipedia article on artificial intelligence: software that learns from data to reason, write, see and act. How many open it each day shows how far the subject reaches beyond the people building it.
wiki-artificial-intelligence.recent: Copper fell to its lowest since July on fears of an AI backlash at the midterms. Nvidia's Jensen Huang then emailed staff a 'confession' about an affair, and Trump backed Lutnick over Nvidia chip controls. Washington later required AI chip licences for firms headquartered in 5 countries, and 10 countries signed a supply-chain pact that China stayed out of.

poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States lifts its naval blockade of Iran by 30 November 2026. The blockade sets how much Iranian oil reaches buyers and how freely tankers move through the Gulf.
poly-us-announces-end-of-iranian-blockad.recent: Money moved away from a lifted blockade as the war widened: the US bombed Qeshm Island, Iran answered with strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain, and a third US carrier reached the Gulf. In Islamabad, Iran shortened its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2, but the talks remain stalled and Iran says mines have hit tankers in the strait.

stocks:UBER.standing: The largest ride-hailing and food-delivery platform outside China, taking a cut of each fare its drivers and couriers carry. Its margins rest on how regulators let it classify and pay those workers.
stocks:UBER.recent: The news about Uber's own business in the window was its exit from Nigeria and a third-party breach it said touched nearly 150,000 people. The breach was disclosed after the latest close, and neither story accounts for the price.

poly-will-anthropics-ipo-valuation-be-be.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, goes public at a valuation between $1.25 trillion and $1.50 trillion. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-variational-fdv-above-1b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Variational's token, once launched, is valued above $1 billion fully diluted a day later. FDV prices every token that will ever exist, not just those trading, so it is how crypto launches are sized.

stocks:AAPL.standing: Shares of Apple, the Cupertino maker of the iPhone, the Mac and a large paid-services business, and one of the most valuable companies listed on the Nasdaq. The iPhone still brings in about half of its revenue.
stocks:AAPL.recent: Apple's iPhone AI launched in China with Alibaba's Qwen powering Siri, Thai officials met Apple over spyware alerts sent to politicians, and Apple said an internal update caused the outage that took its services down. None of it was a result, an order or a ruling that accounts for the share's rise.

stocks:CVX.standing: One of the two largest US oil companies, pumping crude and gas from the Permian Basin to Kazakhstan and Australia's LNG plants and refining it into fuel. Its share price tracks oil prices and its spending on new supply.

stocks:XOM.standing: The largest US oil and gas company, pumping crude and natural gas worldwide and refining it into fuels and chemicals. Its shares move with the oil price and with refining margins.

stocks:TTE.standing: France's largest energy company, producing oil and gas worldwide and ranking among the biggest traders of liquefied natural gas, with a growing power and renewables arm. This series is its New York listing, priced in dollars.
stocks:TTE.recent: West Coast fishers at Port Nolloth are challenging TotalEnergies' offshore drilling, and a High Court judgment on the case is due soon. A pending ruling on one licence does not account for the slide in the share.

poly-will-douard-philippe-win-the-2027-f.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Édouard Philippe, Emmanuel Macron's prime minister from 2020 to 2022 and founder of the Horizons party, wins France's 2027 presidential election, the first Macron cannot contest.

stocks:VALE.standing: Brazil's largest miner and one of the world's biggest iron ore producers, also mining nickel and copper. Its shares trade in New York and follow Chinese steel demand, the main buyer of its ore.

stocks:BRKM5.SA.standing: Brazil's largest petrochemical company and the biggest maker of thermoplastic resins in the Americas, controlled jointly by Novonor and Petrobras. Its profits ride the spread between naphtha feedstock and plastic resin prices.

poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.standing: A Polymarket contract paying out if Houthi forces enter Aden, the southern port where Yemen's internationally recognised government sits, by the end of 2026. Its price is what traders bet on the war's front reaching the south.
poly-houthis-enter-aden-by-december-31-2.recent: Bets on Aden revived once the ground war moved on the coast: Yemen government forces withdrew from an area near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving it in Houthi control, and the Houthis freed 600 fighters as those forces redeployed. Saudi-led strikes on Sanaa and Hodeidah answered Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh.

poly-will-crude-oil-reach-a-new-all-time.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if crude oil sets a new record price before March 2027. The nominal high still dates from the July 2008 spike, so the contract is a bet on a supply shock large enough to beat it.

poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes the Claude models, goes bankrupt before the end of 2027. It prices the risk that a cash-hungry frontier lab runs out of money before its revenue catches up.
poly-will-anthropic-announce-bankruptcy-.recent: The fortnight's news about prediction markets concerned the platforms themselves, with Trump Jr. leaving Kalshi after his firm put money into its rival Polymarket. None of it touched Anthropic's finances or accounts for the price.

wiki-european-central-bank.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on the European Central Bank, the Frankfurt institution that sets interest rates for every country using the euro and supervises its largest banks.
wiki-european-central-bank.recent: Christine Lagarde leaves on 7 February, and the race to succeed her narrowed to Knot and De Cos before Paris and Berlin settled it: Spain gets the presidency and Germany the chief economist seat, for Markus Brunnermeier, after Germany's chancellor and finance minister had rejected each other's candidates.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Bitcoin each day. Bitcoin is the first and largest cryptocurrency, and the article's readership surges when its price swings or when governments move to regulate it.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: Bitcoin fell below $75,000 in a rout of tech stocks that liquidated $1.26 billion in leveraged bets, then kept sliding: spot ETFs lost a net $1.282 billion in a week, MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, and the price briefly went below $62,000.

stocks:TTWO.standing: The New York video game publisher that owns Rockstar Games and 2K, behind Grand Theft Auto, Red Dead Redemption and NBA 2K, plus Zynga's mobile titles. Its share price turns on the timing and sales of a few blockbuster releases.
stocks:TTWO.recent: Grand Theft Auto VI, the game the share has waited on for years, reached players to rave reviews as gamers entered Vice City; a Chennai company gave its staff the day off for the release. In the run-up, Rockstar fired 31 unionising staff in the United Kingdom, and the workers' union fight followed the launch.

poly-will-spacex-have-the-highest-ipo-ma.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether SpaceX, Elon Musk's rocket and Starlink company, goes public in 2026 at a higher market value than any other listing that year. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.

stocks:JD.standing: A Beijing-based online retailer that, unlike marketplace rivals, owns much of the stock it sells and runs its own warehouse and delivery network. Its Nasdaq-listed shares trade as a gauge of Chinese household spending.
stocks:JD.recent: The one story about JD.com's own business landed after the slide, not during it: in Beijing the company reported a 5.2 billion yuan quarterly operating profit, a return to profit. Nothing in the input accounts for the fall in the days before.

poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if J.D. Vance is the Republican nominee for the 2028 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome, and it tracks how secure his claim to succeed Trump looks inside the party.
poly-will-jd-vance-win-the-2028-republic.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about the venues, not the race: Trump Jr. left Kalshi as an advisor after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket, and Warren asked the White House what it was doing to stop bets tied to Trump's teleprompter. None of it bears on who wins the GOP nomination, and nothing in the input accounts for the price.

poly-will-josh-shapiro-win-the-2028-demo.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Josh Shapiro, Pennsylvania's Democratic governor, wins his party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in a field with no declared frontrunner.

poly-anthropic-ipo-closing-market-cap-ab.standing: What traders pay for a contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI company behind Claude, is valued above $1.25 trillion once its shares list publicly. It is a bet on what public markets will pay for a frontier AI lab.

stocks:PANW.standing: One of the largest cybersecurity companies, selling firewalls and network and cloud security software to businesses and governments. Its shares are a read on how much companies spend defending their systems against attack.
stocks:PANW.recent: Palo Alto agreed to buy Applied Compute for $4.5bn on a shift Nikesh Arora put at the centre of the deal: open-weight models went from under 5% to over 60% of AI tokens in a year. Companies host those models themselves, so securing them falls to the enterprise, not the lab. It plans 35 AI security apps, and the shares jumped 8% overnight.

poly-trump-meets-with-kim-jong-un-by-dec.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Donald Trump and North Korea's leader Kim Jong Un meet in person before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, in cents on the dollar.
poly-trump-meets-with-kim-jong-un-by-dec.recent: Trump is courting Kim Jong Un for a summit even as the IAEA says North Korea is expanding its uranium-enrichment plant at Yongbyon, and Washington has dropped denuclearisation from its stated priorities and cut back drills with Seoul. His Asia trip ran through Manila to Shenzhen, where he met Putin and Xi, with no meeting with Kim on it.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-betwe.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, lists its shares by 2027 at a first-day market value between $0.9 and $1.2 trillion. One price bets on both the listing and its size.

poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Federal Reserve raises its policy rate by a quarter point at its January 2027 meeting. That rate sets the cost of dollar borrowing for governments, firms and households worldwide.
poly-will-the-fed-increase-interest-rate.recent: Hot October inflation, with consumer prices up 0.4% against forecasts, turned the Fed from holding to raising: Logan called for two more hikes, Waller for weighing a half-point move, and the minutes showed almost all officials expected further tightening. Deutsche Bank and J.P. Morgan now see hikes at three straight meetings.

stocks:DB.standing: The New York Stock Exchange listing, in dollars, of Germany's largest bank, based in Frankfurt. Its big investment bank makes it Europe's most watched lender for trading income and for fines over compliance failures.
stocks:DB.recent: The shares fell after a leak of 15 million internal files showed the bank kept about 28,000 clients its own compliance had flagged, and that a May 2020 memo tied two Trump companies to laundromats. Later files showed staff excusing Brazilian clients Vale and Braskem, and softening cartel and slave-labour allegations against Cutrale.

stocks:SONY.standing: US-listed shares of Sony Group, the Tokyo conglomerate behind PlayStation, Sony Music and Sony Pictures, and the biggest maker of smartphone camera sensors. Games and music now earn it more than electronics do.

stocks:LMT.standing: The largest US defence contractor, maker of the F-35 fighter, missile systems and NASA's Orion crew capsule. Most of its revenue comes from the US government, so its shares move on Pentagon budgets and large contract awards.
stocks:LMT.recent: What the news did carry on the company came after its October swings: the rocket venture Lockheed Martin shares with Boeing failed minutes after launch, destroying 40 Amazon Leo satellites, and the Artemis change left Orion to be pushed by Starship at up to 1 g. Neither accounts for the share price.

poly-variational-fdv-above-2b-one-day-af.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Variational, a crypto derivatives trading platform, is worth more than $2 billion on a fully diluted basis the day after its token launches. That counts every token that will ever exist, not only those trading.
poly-variational-fdv-above-2b-one-day-af.recent: The fortnight's news on prediction markets was about the venues themselves: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival Polymarket. None of it concerned Variational or its launch, and nothing in it accounts for the price.

poly-will-puma-shen-win-the-next-taipei-.standing: What traders pay for a contract that settles yes if Puma Shen, a Democratic Progressive Party legislator, becomes mayor of Taipei. The capital has not elected a DPP mayor since Chen Shui-bian won in 1994.

poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Ron DeSantis, the Florida Republican who ran for the 2024 nomination and quit early, wins the White House in 2028. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.
poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.recent: The window carried Donald Trump's crushing midterm defeat, which JD Vance blamed on the Iran war, and Trump making Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle. None of it names DeSantis or a 2028 field, so nothing in it accounts for the bets.

stocks:OHB.DE.standing: A Bremen-based space company listed in Frankfurt, and Europe's third satellite builder after Airbus and Thales. It builds the Galileo navigation satellites, so its fortunes ride on European Space Agency and EU budgets.
stocks:OHB.DE.recent: The one story about OHB's own business came at the end of the slide: the European Space Agency ordered a €102m satellite catcher, ClearSpace-1, with the work centred on Bremen. The order arrived after the fall, and nothing in the input explains the drop from late October.
